algorithm.title: Evaluation of the Patient With Acute Respiratory Infection.

cell.label: Patient reports symptoms of: headache, sneezing, sore throat, rhinorrhea, malaise, or cough
Symptoms of acute rhinosinusitis: URI symptoms that have not improved after 10 days or worsen after 5-7 days.
Symptoms of streptococcal pharyngitis: fever, tonsillopharyngeal erythema and exudates, anterior cervical adenopathy, absence of cough.
Symptoms of influenza: abrupt onset of constitutional and respiratory symptoms, particularly accompanied by myalgias and fatigue.
Symptoms of otitis media: bulging, limited mobility, erythema, or air fluid level of tympanic membrane; otorrhea; or distinct otalgia.
Symptoms of pneumonia: fever, tachypnea, tachycardia, abnormal chest examination, or abnormal chest x-ray.
Symptoms of common cold: sinus, pharyngeal, and lower airway symptoms are present, but not prominent.

footnotes.footnote: From the Institute for Clinical Systems Improvement. Health Care Guideline: Diagnosis and Treatment of Respiratory Illness in Children and Adults, 5th ed.
